blocks.text: Trailer Lettering and Decals: A Branding Must-Have

blocks.alt: Lettering & Decal - 14' Trailer - 3M & Avery Dennison - Holistic

blocks.html:
Vinyl wrapping has become increasingly popular in recent years, especially when it comes to vehicle wrapping. Businesses are now taking advantage of this trend by promoting their brands on their vehicles, which can be seen by a wide range of audiences as they drive around town. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we specialize in creating custom vinyl wraps for all types of vehicles, including trailers. Recently, we had the opportunity to install lettering and decals on a 14′ trailer for our client, Holistic. In this blog post, we’ll walk you through the installation process and explain how getting promotional decals on a trailer can help a business.

Step 1: Design

Before we started the installation process, we first had to design the lettering and decals for Holistic’s trailer. Our client provided us with their logo and branding guidelines, and we worked with them to come up with a design that would effectively promote their brand. Once the design was finalized, we printed it on high-quality vinyl using our state-of-the-art printers.

Step 2: Preparation

The next step was to prepare the trailer for the installation process. We cleaned the surface of the trailer thoroughly to remove any dirt or debris. We also removed any existing graphics or decals to ensure a smooth surface for the new graphics.

Step 3: Installation

The actual installation process involved applying the vinyl lettering and decals onto the trailer’s surface. We carefully positioned each letter and decal to ensure that they were straight and aligned. We also used a squeegee to remove any air bubbles and to smooth out any wrinkles in the vinyl. The installation process was time-consuming, but we took our time to ensure that the final product looked professional and visually appealing.

Step 4: Final touches

After the vinyl lettering and decals were installed, we added a layer of protective laminate to prevent fading and damage from the elements. This added layer also made it easier to clean and maintain the graphics in the future.

How getting promotional decals on a trailer can help a business

Now that we’ve explained the installation process, let’s talk about how getting promotional decals on a trailer can help a business. Trailers are versatile vehicles that can be used for a variety of purposes, from transporting goods to serving as mobile offices. Adding promotional decals to a trailer can help a business in several ways, including:

1. Increased brand visibility

When a trailer is out on the road, it’s essentially a moving billboard. By adding custom decals and lettering, a business can effectively promote their brand to a wide range of audiences. Whether the trailer is parked on a busy street or travelling down the highway, people will notice the graphics and remember the brand.

2. Professional appearance

Vinyl lettering and decals are a cost-effective way to give a trailer a professional appearance. By adding graphics that feature the business’s logo, contact information, and other relevant information, the trailer will look like a professional and trustworthy business.

3. Brand consistency

By using the same logo and branding elements on a trailer as on other marketing materials, a business can create brand consistency. This consistency reinforces the brand identity and helps to build trust and recognition with potential customers.

4. Flexibility

Trailers can be used for a variety of purposes, and adding custom graphics makes them even more versatile. Whether a business uses the trailer to transport goods or as a mobile office, the promotional decals can be updated or changed to reflect the current marketing campaign or message.

Conclusion

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we take pride in helping businesses promote their brands with custom vinyl wraps. The recent installation of lettering and decals on a 14′ trailer for Holistic is just one example of the many projects we’ve completed for our clients. By adding promotional decals to a trailer, businesses can increase brand visibility, create a professional appearance, create brand consistency, and have a flexible marketing tool that can be used for a variety of purposes. With the ability to reach a wide range of audiences as they travel on the road, trailers with custom graphics are an effective marketing tool that can help businesses stand out from their competition. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we work closely with our clients to create custom designs that effectively promote their brands and help them achieve their marketing goals. Whether it’s a small trailer or a fleet of vehicles, we have the expertise and experience to create high-quality vinyl wraps that will exceed our clients’ expectations. Contact us today to learn more about how we can help promote your business with custom vinyl wraps.
